main_text.p: berrimus, sese in vno Christo exerens, vobis conti[?] adsit, vosque ab omni malo incolumes, omniqué be[?] dictionum genere lucupletatos reddat.

Versf. 24. Charitas mea cum omnibus vobis in Christo [?]su. i. ego vehementissimo affectu à summa chari[?] proveniente, vobis omnia bona in Christo exopto, precor vt gratia Christi sit vobiscum. Amen.

page.notes: Right-hand and lower portions of the text are cut off by the scan edge, so the line endings are incomplete. Several words in the final lines are partly obscured by show-through and are marked [?]. The large ornament below FINIS is a woodcut tailpiece and is not transcribed.
